snippet.title: BLOODLETTER Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
BLOODLETTER is a grim medieval deckbuilder where you use your dubious healing methods to protect bizarre villagers from the corrupting influence of ancient evils.

BLOODLETTER goes into Early Access on 30.03.2026. Purchase the game on steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3493400/BLOODLETTER/?
